slides.text: Ever wondered what's actually happening when an AI voice agent answers your call?
slides.voiceover_text: Ever wondered what's actually happening when an AI voice agent picks up your business phone? It's simpler than you'd think.

slides.text: Speech recognition turns the caller's words into text.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one: speech recognition. It turns the caller's actual words into text in real time as they're speaking.

slides.text: Natural language processing works out what they actually want.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two: natural language processing. It works out the caller's real intent, not just the literal words they used.

slides.text: Integration logic checks your calendar or CRM and acts on it.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip three: integration logic. It connects to your calendar or CRM to actually book the job or log the enquiry, not just chat.

slides.text: Not a script reader. Not an IVR menu. Real understanding, acting in real time.
slides.voiceover_text: So remember: it's not a script reader and it's not an IVR menu. It's real understanding, acting on your systems in real time.

youtubeDescription: Speech recognition, natural language processing, integration logic. Three linked systems, not a script reader or an IVR menu.
geo_answer: An AI voice agent works using three linked systems: speech recognition to convert spoken words into text, natural language processing to determine the caller's intent, and integration logic that connects to a calendar, CRM or job management system to act on the request in real time.
geo_takeaways: AI voice agents differ from traditional answering services and IVR menus because they interpret intent rather than routing calls or matching pre-recorded options.
Integration into a business's actual calendar and CRM is what allows an AI voice agent to book appointments and log enquiries without human involvement.
A call handled by an AI voice agent is transcribed and actioned in real time, so a caller can get a booking confirmed in the same conversation rather than waiting for a callback.
